content: Valve just leaked several new videos showing the Steam Frame’s unboxing, setup process, and various accessories. The videos apparently appeared on the ARM Steam client following an update, but they were “quickly pulled after that,” according to the Steam Hardware Updates account on X. The Steam Frame is Valve’s virtual-reality headset that can stream games from a PC or play them locally. Valve first took the wraps off the headset last year, and it offers LCD screens with 2160 x 2160 resolution per eye, a Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 chip, and an up to 110-degree field of view. But these leaked videos offer a closer look at what it might be like to unbox and set up the new device. [Media: https://twitter.com/HardwareSteam/status/2090046986900717837] As shown in one of the videos, Valve shows how you can use the Steam Frame’s “pivot arms” to adjust the position of the headset, as well as how to insert a spacer beneath the face gasket if you wear glasses. Another video details how you can plug the wireless dongle into your PC or Steam Machine to stream games. There’s an “Ergonomic Accessories Kit” as well, which includes hand straps to keep your hands attached to the controller, along with a top head strap to “improve weight distribution and provide “extra headset stability.” The kit also has an extended light blocker designed for people with smaller noses, as it can better seal the area between their face and the Steam Frame. You can find the links to all of Valve’s leaked videos from this post on Reddit. Though Valve previously said that it plans to release the Steam Frame this summer, it hasn’t yet shared an exact launch date. Still, that timeframe, these setup videos, and a recent 13-ton shipment of VR headsets could all indicate that a launch is right around the corner.
chineseTitle: 观看 Valve 在自己泄露的视频中设置 Steam 框架
chineseSummary: Valve 刚刚泄露了几段新视频，展示了 Steam Frame 的拆箱、安装过程和各种配件。这些视频显然是在更新后出现在 ARM Steam 客户端上的，但根据 X 上的 Steam 硬件更新帐户，它们“很快就被删除了”。Steam Frame 是 Valve 的虚拟现实耳机，可以流式传输游戏 […]
chineseContent: Valve 刚刚泄露了几段新视频，展示了 Steam Frame 的拆箱、安装过程和各种配件。据 X 上的 Steam 硬件更新帐户称，这些视频显然是在更新后出现在 ARM Steam 客户端上的，但“之后很快就被删除了”。Steam Frame 是 Valve 的虚拟现实耳机，可以从 PC 流式传输游戏或在本地玩游戏。 Valve 去年首次揭开了这款耳机的面纱，它配备了单眼分辨率为 2160 x 2160 的 LCD 屏幕、Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 芯片和高达 110 度的视野。但这些泄露的视频让我们更仔细地了解了新设备的拆箱和安装情况。 [媒体：https://twitter.com/HardwareSteam/status/2090046986900717837] 如其中一个视频所示，Valve 向您展示了如何使用 Steam Frame 的“枢轴臂”来调整耳机的位置，以及如果您戴眼镜，如何在面部垫圈下方插入垫片。另一个视频详细介绍了如何将无线适配器插入 PC 或 Steam 机器以串流游戏。还有一个“人体工程学配件套件”，其中包括用于将手固定在控制器上的手带，以及用于“改善重量分布并提供“额外的耳机稳定性”的头顶带。该套件还具有专为鼻子较小的人设计的扩展遮光器，因为它可以更好地密封他们的脸部和蒸汽框架之间的区域。您可以从 Reddit 上的这篇文章中找到 Valve 所有泄露视频的链接。尽管 Valve 此前表示计划在今年夏天发布 Steam Frame，但尚未透露确切的发布日期。尽管如此，这个时间范围、这些设置视频以及最近发货的 13 吨 VR 耳机都可能表明发布即将到来。
